experiments.scope: Exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 root compression on 64-byte messages. Per organizer seed, one run of the algorithm of proof.md Section 3 scaled to N_t = 2^10 messages: 32 groups (fresh seed-derived words U0, U1 = m0..m14 per group) x 32 enumerated values t = 0..31 of the round-1 state word a3', m15 = (t - S) mod 2^32. Digest words o0..o3 and o5 are produced only by the grouped per-message evaluator (proof.md Section 4); the scaled key is the 20-bit event mask (4 bits in each of o0, o1, o2, o3, o5) applied to the packed key; the operation-counted sparse-set step of Section 5 runs over adversarial garbage memory (about half of the unwritten words carry a pointer to a written dense entry); a key match is re-hashed with an independent reference compression before the pair is returned. Every organizer trial is returned, failures as two nulls; observations report the counted body/key operations of the first message and the table-step operation range.
experiments.hypothesis: The success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with the uniform-random value for the same event (1024 values, 20-bit agreement: 0.3933, proof.md Section 7), as heuristic H1 predicts for the full-scale grouped message set. Each success is a pair of distinct messages whose complete 2-round BLAKE3 digests agree on the 20 masked bits.

experiments.scope: As b3r2-grouped-spread, but all 1024 messages of a trial lie in one group (one seed-derived m0..m14, t = 0..1023): the most structured layout, in which messages differ only in m15. A different 20-bit mask, again 4 bits in each of o0, o1, o2, o3, o5.
experiments.hypothesis: Within-group digests also behave like independent uniform values for the masked event: the success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with 0.3933. Each success is a pair of distinct messages whose complete 2-round BLAKE3 digests agree on the 20 masked bits.

experiments.scope: Evidence for the digest words that the counted hot path never computes. As b3r2-grouped-spread (32 groups x t = 0..31, same message set, same grouped evaluator, same table step over adversarial garbage), but the evaluator runs in its evidence-only full mode, which also performs the three skipped final b rotations and outputs all eight digest words o0..o7; the scaled key is a 20-bit mask spread over all eight words (3 bits in each of o0..o3, 2 bits in each of o4..o7) applied to the packed 256-bit digest. The counted per-message program of proof.md Section 4 is unchanged; this experiment only tests the full-digest premise of H1.
experiments.hypothesis: The grouped digests also behave like independent uniform values on o4, o6 and o7: the success frequency agrees, within sampling error, with the uniform-random value 0.3933 for 1024 values and a 20-bit event. Each success is a pair of distinct messages whose complete 2-round BLAKE3 digests agree on the 20 masked bits.
